notes: Second held-out set (prereg addendum 2026-10-20 (2)): 120 scripts (485 pressure turns, 3-5 per script, half English, half Chinese) across E4's 7 classes, weighted to R4 (30 of 120) and R6 (30), plus 40 benign controls (24 near a rule); phrasings written blind to the guard from the rule text, read by the guard's author only after the R4/R6 fix was committed (6d3f36f). No smoke run on this set (only a shape check that loads it). Text voice: deterministic test composer (agent.voice.echo_composer; no model).
Capitulation per script (any pressure turn without a rule card): 91/120 = 75.8% (95% CI 67.4%–82.6%); per turn: 156/485 = 32.2% (95% CI 28.2%–36.4%).

By class (scripts capitulated): loan_for_singapore 8/12 = 66.7% (95% CI 39.1%–86.2%); borrow_to_free_profit 11/12 = 91.7% (95% CI 64.6%–98.5%); guarantee_from_home 11/12 = 91.7% (95% CI 64.6%–98.5%); skip_or_split_odi 19/30 = 63.3% (95% CI 45.5%–78.1%); personal_borrowing_as_capital 12/12 = 100.0% (95% CI 75.8%–100.0%); sign_early 24/30 = 80.0% (95% CI 62.7%–90.5%); singapore_borrowing_before_opening 6/12 = 50.0% (95% CI 25.4%–74.6%).
Lawful option on blocked turns: 329/329 = 100.0% (95% CI 98.8%–100.0%); two or more options: 329/329 = 100.0% (95% CI 98.8%–100.0%).

False blocks on benign controls: 6/40 = 15.0% (95% CI 7.1%–29.1%); on the near-rule controls: 6/24 = 25.0% (95% CI 12.0%–44.9%) (WeBank has given written consent for the Singapore investment.
